evidence.activity: Custom 'Leading with Values' leadership development program run with INSEAD for company leaders
evidence.quote: By mid-2025, 180 leaders across five global cohorts had participated, focusing on emotional intelligence, constructive feedback, inclusive decision-making and storytelling as a cultural tool.
evidence.section: Sustainability Report > Talent Attraction, Development & Retention > Leadership Skills

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Online and instructor-led employee learning programs, with a global Learning Management System introduced in 2025
evidence.quote: Belimo has expanded its learning offers with both online and instructor-led programs, providing employees with diverse development opportunities worldwide.
evidence.section: Sustainability Report > Talent Attraction, Development & Retention > Upgrading Employee Skills and Transition Assistance Programs
evidence.indicators: 32 average hours of training per FTE

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Employee courses that include intercultural competencies and language training
evidence.quote: Courses cover effective communication, negotiation, conflict management, intercultural competencies, and language training.
evidence.section: Sustainability Report > Talent Attraction, Development & Retention > Career Development

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current activity, limited in reach (intercultural and language training, no figures)

evidence.activity: Participation in disability employment programs that bring people with physical or mental disabilities into work at Belimo
evidence.quote: In 2025, 76 individuals contributed their skills to Belimo through disability employment programs (2024: 65 individuals).
evidence.section: Sustainability Report > Our Employees > Equal Opportunity

cross_cultural.criterion: level 3: specific current inclusion program for people with disabilities, with participant figures

evidence.activity: Women in CleanTech event and work with LIMES and SVIN, associations for women students and engineers, to reach underrepresented female engineers
evidence.quote: In 2025 Belimo conducted the Women in CleanTech event for the second time to increase the visibility of Belimo towards female engineers.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current outreach to an underrepresented group, limited reach, no figures

evidence.activity: Inclusion@Hinwil pilot (onboarding, awareness training, feedback processes) and inclusive language in HR processes
evidence.quote: In 2025, Belimo launched several DEI-related initiatives, including the Inclusion@Hinwil pilot (onboarding, awareness training, role clarity & feedback processes), as well as the introduction of inclusive language across HR processes.
evidence.section: Sustainability Report > Our Employees > Management Approach

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current activity, limited in reach (single-site pilot)

evidence.activity: Multilingual whistleblower and grievance channel available around the clock
evidence.quote: This grievance mechanism is operated by an external provider and is available 24/7 in German, English, and Chinese; reports can be entered in all languages.
evidence.section: Sustainability Report > Policies & Compliance > Grievance Mechanism and Integrity Channel

evidence.quote: In 2025, women represented 38.8% of Belimo’s total workforce (2024: 37.3%).

creativity.reason: Level 0: the report fully describes an HVAC field-device business (actuators, valves, sensors) with no creative work. 'Design' means engineering design and 'storytelling' is used only as a leadership tool, so neither counts.

community.reason: Level 2: the documented activities are employee development (Leading with Values for 180 leaders, 32 training hours per FTE), so the employee-development cap of 2 applies.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 3: participation in disability employment programs is a specific current inclusion activity with participant figures (76 individuals), backed by several smaller internal practices.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 0: the business description is sufficient and shows no service or program that enables founders or small businesses; references to innovation and to board members' personal entrepreneurship mandates are traps.

ai.notes: Exclusions: Training for HVAC professionals and 'market education' in Asia Pacific were treated as customer and product education, so they did not count for Community. The Belimo Climate Foundation funds emissions reduction through building optimization; it is climate-focused, has no education or community reach figures, and was not counted for Community. Exchanges with academia are R&D collaboration, not education. Board members' and the CEO's external mandates (e.g. advisory board of the foundation >>venture>>) are personal roles, not company activities. Status of programs: Inclusion@Hinwil is a pilot at one site. Leading with Values becomes part of the Leadership Framework from 2026. The Belimo Leadership Accelerator (20 participants since 2021) is being redesigned, with its next intake planned for Q4/2026. Several mental-health initiatives are planned, not current. Gender representation: board female representation (25%) is below the company's own 30% target. Integrity Channel: three minor reports in 2025, none classified as discrimination, so no rights finding. Indicative total: 0 + 12 + 12 + 0 = 24/100.
